name: SushiSwap V3 Factory

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Factory.owner() is an Ownable2Step fee-manager wrapper whose owner is a plain 2-of-3 Safe - not found at the same address on Ethereum/Arbitrum/Base/BSC/Optimism, no public documentation of its signers found.
narrative.detail: Factory and pools are immutable, so the blast radius is fee/tier control, not fund custody. Address sourced from Sushi’s own canonical chain config, not a third-party mirror.
